_meta._note: S213 6-month Medical-AI gap sweep (6 parallel research agents). NEW frontier medical benchmarks (MedBench v5 / Medmarks / LiveMedBench / PhysicianBench / Chi-Bench / PhysAssistBench / ER-Reason / X-PCR / SpineBench / MentalBench / GI-Bench / M3CoTBench) with scores attached ONLY to frontier models already in the DB (absent competitors like Baichuan-M3/Doubao/Seed skipped, no stubs). NEW models: MedMO-8B, Aloe-Vision-72B, OpenMedReason-7B, LePaX, MeDxAgent, RadSight-8B, PulmoFoundation — scores mapped to existing standard benches (slake/vqa_rad/pmc_vqa/pathmmu/omnimedvqa/mmlu_med/mmmu_medical/medxpertqa) + LePaX to mimic_cxr_* RRG. Win-rate benches x100. All numbers from primary arXiv papers. SKIPPED (aggregator-only/unreadable, per strict attribution): MedArena live BT, MedHELM-Q2 task numbers, HealthBench/MedXpertQA aggregator numbers, and items with no primary numeric scores (MedDialogRubrics figures, MMRad-22K, CXR-LT 2026, JEPA-DNA, etc.).
